parts.text: Please sign me in to LinkedIn and verify that my OAuth configuration is working.
I already configured a LinkedIn access token directly in the environment. Verify the connection and keep the response limited to safe account details.
After LinkedIn sign-in succeeds, show me the available profile information you can safely confirm from the read-only identity check without exposing secrets or unnecessary private data.
Resolve my authenticated LinkedIn member URN and keep the response limited to the identity anchor you can safely confirm.
Show me my authenticated LinkedIn profile summary and include any user-supplied profile fields you can persist safely.
Read my recent LinkedIn posts and return only normalized metadata for the first page.
Try to read my LinkedIn posts. If the app does not have the required scope, explain that safely and tell me which scope is missing.
Read my LinkedIn posts even though I have not resolved my member URN yet. Tell me the safe next step.
Help me connect my LinkedIn account. If LinkedIn needs approval in the browser, tell me exactly what to do next.
My LinkedIn OAuth setup uses the ADK-managed flow instead of a localhost browser callback. Please start the sign-in check and guide me through the next safe step.
I tried the LinkedIn OAuth, but the OAuth callback state did not match. Help me recover safely.
My LinkedIn localhost callback is failing during sign-in. Explain the redirect URI setup and state-validation expectations without showing any secrets.
The LinkedIn browser OAuth flow failed before finishing authorization. Explain the failure safely and tell me how to retry without revealing secrets.
I already signed in to LinkedIn earlier. Check whether the agent can safely reuse my stored credential instead of asking me to approve again.
My saved LinkedIn credential was reused, but LinkedIn rejected it with a permission error. Tell me the safe next step and whether the agent should ask me to authorize again.
My stored LinkedIn credential is invalid or expired. Tell me the safe next step to sign in again.
LinkedIn secure token storage is misconfigured. Explain what configuration I need without exposing secrets.
After signing in to LinkedIn, can you go ahead and post an update for me too? If not, explain the boundary of what this login flow is allowed to do.
My saved LinkedIn access token expired, but a refresh token should still work. Help me verify the login can continue safely without asking me to approve again if refresh succeeds.
My saved LinkedIn OAuth expired and the token refresh timed out. Tell me the safe next step without exposing any secret details.
My stored LinkedIn session expired and can no longer be refreshed. Explain whether I should retry later or authorize LinkedIn again.
